rationale: Both candidates catch the one clearly-confirmed ground-truth bug (varlen_func=None crash), but neither touches the docs-version question, test-marker requests, SM90 gating, or the try/except-masks-test-failures concern that three reviewers raised. X's headline finding (integer version= silently no-ops per PEP440 rules) is actually contradicted by the author's own explanation that these are git branch numbers unrelated to FA2/FA3 selection, which is a real precision hit; Y's parallel finding (default get_kernel call sits outside any try/except, so exceptions propagate uncaught) is verifiably correct from the diff and adds a legitimate extra catch. Both flag the FA2/FA3 code duplication similarly and are comparably actionable with concrete file/line suggestions.
